SELECT tt.biz01_promo_id AS promo_id , COALESCE(tt.biz01_close_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS close_yn , tt.biz01_close_nm AS close_name , tt.biz01_html_card_nm AS html_card_name , tt.biz01_approval_dt AS approval_dt , tt.biz01_franchise_nm AS franchise_name , tt.biz01_sector_nm AS sector_name , tt.biz01_provide_amt AS provide_amt , tt.biz01_reg_emp_nm AS reg_emp_name FROM ( SELECT t.* , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz01_close_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '마감' ELSE '' END AS biz01_close_nm , crd02_approval_dt AS biz01_approval_dt , crd02_franchise_nm AS biz01_franchise_nm , crd02_sector_nm AS biz01_sector_nm , crd01_card_nm AS biz01_html_card_nm , CASE WHEN crd03_public_yn = 'true' AND biz01_real_person_id IS NULL THEN '공통' WHEN crd03_public_yn = 'true' AND biz01_real_person_id IS NOT NULL THEN f_emp_kor_nm(biz01_real_person_id) ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(crd03_person_id) END AS biz01_reg_emp_nm , crd02_approval_time AS biz01_approval_time , crd03_public_yn AS biz01_public_yn FROM ( SELECT * FROM biz01_promo INNER JOIN crd02_data ON crd02_data_id = biz01_card_data_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = biz01_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN crd01_card ON crd01_card_id = biz01_card_id LEFT OUTER JOIN crd03_trans ON ( crd03_card_id = biz01_card_id AND biz01_provide_date BETWEEN crd03_fr_dt AND COALESCE(crd03_to_dt,'9999-12-31') ) LEFT OUTER JOIN act01_account_code ON (act01_account_code_id = biz01_account_code_id) WHERE biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(biz01_provide_pur_cd,'%') LIKE #{providePurCode} AND biz01_std_ym = #{dataYm} ) t ) tt WHERE 1=1 AND biz01_public_yn = 'true'
AND biz01_real_person_id IS NULL
ORDER BY biz01_approval_dt, biz01_approval_time, biz01_franchise_nm
